documentAccounting.note: Valid cases are stored in both carriers, 19 x 2 = 38. Defect fixtures are stored in the cpol: form only, 9. Eight of the nine are additionally exercised through the ODRL carrier at test time; the ninth declares two policies, which has no ODRL-carrier form because the mapping is defined for exactly one policy node.

mlcroissant.note: Every valid case in both carriers. Errors: none. The two recommended-property warnings that remain on the deployment examples remain here, plus schema:license, which these fixtures do not carry because they are not distributed datasets.

purpose: Specification coverage for the Croissant policy profile. Generated from the closed grammar, not observed. Makes no claim about which policies are written in practice, and carries no timing figures: those come from the deployment corpus of real nf-core descriptors.

shacl.note: Invisible defects are of two kinds and both are boundaries rather than gaps. A duplicated condition name violates a relationship between sibling nodes, which only SHACL-SPARQL could express -- the unbounded fragment this profile declines. A malformed operand lives inside cpol:expected, which is an rdf:JSON literal the shapes cannot see into. Both are refused by the evaluator and reported by the structural validator.
